mechanism: Ritonavir is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase minocycline concentrations, while minocycline may induce CYP3A4; additionally, both drugs can cause photosensitivity and hepatotoxicity.
action: Monitor for minocycline toxicity signs (vertigo, photosensitivity, hepatic dysfunction); consider alternative antibiotic if clinically feasible; ensure adequate sun protection and monitor liver function tests.
